svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: S&P 500 stock index, daily close, January 2006 to March 2013
svg.desc: A line of the S&P 500 index: about 1,250 to 1,550 in 2006 and 2007, a peak of 1,565 on October 9, 2007, a fall to a low of 677 on March 9, 2009, highlighted, 57 percent below the peak, and a recovery to 1,569 on March 28, 2013, where the line ends, the first close above the 2007 peak. A dashed line marks Lehman's failure on September 15, 2008.
